title: Best Documentaries on Netflix
intro: Truth is stranger and darker than fiction. These six will shake you and spark arguments that last all week.

films.title: The Keepers
films.line: A decades-old murder and a cover-up so deep it will hollow you out.

films.title: The Imposter
films.line: A missing boy comes home, except nothing about him is right.

films.title: The Watcher
films.line: A dream home becomes a living dread when someone knows every move you make.

films.title: Icarus
films.line: A casual experiment spirals into one of the most explosive real-world conspiracies ever caught on film.

films.title: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
films.line: Charisma, delusion, and billions of dollars collide in a story stranger than any thriller you could invent.

films.title: Athlete A
films.line: Behind the gold medals and standing ovations, investigators uncover a silence that protected the wrong people.
